# Jesse Wunderlich

> Personal site for Jesse Wunderlich — USMC Sgt (ret), UAS/ScanEagle operator, serial builder, husband and dad in Frazee, Minnesota. Hand-coded, static, no trackers.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/): Who Jesse is, at a glance.
- [About](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/about/): Background — military service, family, the long game.
- [Projects](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/projects/): What Jesse is building — Nova Net Worth, Sardonyx Software, temperat.io.
- [Uses](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/uses/): Hardware, software, and tools Jesse uses to build.
- [Links](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/links/): Where to find Jesse elsewhere on the web.
- [Guestbook](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/guestbook/): Leave a note, backed by GitHub Discussions.

## Reference
- [Sitemap](https://www.jesse-wunderlich.com/sitemap-index.xml): Full site index.
